files.ownership: TeamRouteReason Korean UI + FocusReferenceHall/FocusCity floor synchronization only; navigation unchanged

assumptions: One fire and one EMS training allocation, not real fleet counts
8 m/s design travel speed, not measured emergency ETA
Representative building and station staging connectors are approximate, not verified entrances
Only ground-level public motor roads; bridges/tunnels/nonzero layers and conditional restrictions excluded
OSM turn-restriction relations are not modeled; route is training geometry, not legal navigation advice

gates.sourceRouteStructure: PASS independent directed return, endpoints consistent, one way ID per edge
gates.unityCompile: PASS root before latest UI-only patch; latest UI compile PENDING root
gates.nativeRoundtrip: PASS reported by root: paused request, accepted road movement, arrival 135s, own field ACK 170s, busy return rejected, paused return, Ready 343s. Latest patch changes UI only; targeted Ready HUD verification PENDING root.
gates.presentationContext: PENDING root targeted fresh city→site→city callbacks; no mission/nav/clock change or full-trip rerun in this patch

publicAPI.clock: Director.Receive acceptedDelta invokes AdvanceAcceptedTime including in-flight accepted response during pause; settled pause has no deltas. ResetMissions on explicit run restart.
publicAPI.fieldBusy: TeamTasks.HasActiveTask(teamId); return rejected while active or pending workspace orders
publicAPI.planning: Director.CanPlanAgencyOrders permits request/return while tactically paused; requests move only on next accepted positive delta. Return request and actual start have separate event records.

limitations: Other three coordinate-ready agencies are focus-only; unsupported dispatch/hospital handoff is explicit
Approximate building-to-road and station staging connectors; no surveyed entrance
OnScene enables existing task/worker ACK only; no cure or extinguish on arrival
Native visual fit, vehicle heading, UI and full cycle require root verification
Source roads have conservative surface exclusions and do not model turn-restriction relations
